diagnosis: TaskVine runtime debug, taskgraph, and transaction logs were written synchronously to the same NFS filesystem as the benchmark. The resulting multi-GiB control-plane stream accompanied repeated manager read failures and worker removal, so it polluted the intended data-plane measurement.
resolution: Place TaskVine and DataVine runtime-info streams on node-local /tmp scratch. SharedFS source reads, the DataVine durable journal, requested C outputs, summaries, samples, and hashes remain on campaign storage.
